services.desc: The Boulder County Housing Authority (BCHA) offers rental homes in communities across Boulder County. Homes range from small studio apartments to larger four-bedroom units. You can find them in Lafayette, Longmont, Louisville, Lyons, and Nederland. BCHA is a nonprofit that provides safe, quality homes at prices that are affordable for local residents. Welcome! services.desc: Boulder County Area Agency on Aging (BCAAA) is committed to serving LGBTQ+ older adults in Boulder County. The Rainbow Elders program hosts our annual Lavender Gala each holiday season. Join us for an afternoon of food, entertainment, dancing, and door prizes celebrating Boulder County’s LGBTQ+ older adults! The 26th annual Lavender Gala will take place on Sunday, Dec. 6 from noon-3 p.m. at Nissi’s in Lafayette. Check back with us for registration details in October!
